question: Which country ships more black pepper abroad than any other?
answer: Vietnam. It grew about a third of the world's pepper in 2022 and supplied nearly three-fifths of all exports from producing countries. Planting took off in the 1990s on the red basalt soils of the Central Highlands. India, pepper's home, now eats most of what it grows.
move: A place famous for a product may no longer be where it comes from.
trap: The Malabar coast owns the history, so it seems to own the trade.
